india_trends.title: IMF raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7%

india_trends.title: Vedanta dividend alert! Last day to buy shares of Anil Agarwal-led company for Rs 5/share dividend
india_trends.summary: The company last week declared the interim dividend, which marks its first payout since the stock adjusted for its mega demerger earlier this year. The total dividend payout will be Rs 1,955 crore. Vedanta is closely watched by investors for its consistent track record of dividend payments.
